steps.notes: Stack-aware baseline test scaffold contract is defined for node, python, go, java, and dotnet in execute guidance.
Execute guidance requires generating missing baseline unit/integration/acceptance test assets with deterministic path evidence.
Runbook wiring preserves existing non-empty TEST_COMMAND and sets deterministic baseline command only when unset.
QA findings include baseline test auto-run command execution and output evidence in tests/report.md.
Deterministic fail-closed diagnostics are present for unresolved stack, unsupported stack, and scaffold generation failures.
Non-destructive scaffold ownership rules preserve user-authored tests/commands and fill only missing baseline assets.
Generated test behavior is explicitly integrated with runtime QA autopilot requirements to prevent false PASS on non-starting apps.
Active/template parity is verified across execute, qa, verify-work, release, runbook, and README surfaces.
Regression assertions cover fresh generation, rerun idempotence, preserve-existing behavior, and unsupported-stack fail-fast scenarios.
Verify-work and release gates now require deterministic generated-test readiness evidence references before handoff.
